sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup and inputs
sections.what: Loads the prepared data, the wind report, the project list, the source pack, the conform, evidence, anchoring and reconcile helpers, and the retrieval records, and starts a check counter.
sections.why: Likely reason: every input is loaded before any check runs. Otherwise not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Paths are built from the file's own location, so moving this file breaks every path.

sections.name: test (part 1)
sections.title: Checks on imported wind data (first half)
sections.what: Checks that the 13 wind ranks map to 11 projects with exactly three linked existing records. It also checks that all source and bibliography references survive the import with their URLs, dates and read basis intact. Every original value must match the report exactly, and only metadata may be corrected, not facts or roles.
sections.why: Each check uses the `test` helper, which runs a check and counts it as passed. The aim is that the imported record stays faithful to the source report.
sections.watch_out: Several checks hard-code exact counts such as 85 bibliography and 66 source references, so any change to the source data needs these numbers updated.

sections.name: test (part 2)
sections.title: Checks on imported wind data (second half)
sections.what: Checks that each claim links to the right references and that no non-financial claim cites a source it does not name. It also checks that quotes can be shared across fields and documents, that currency and range qualifiers survive, that no fixed budget fields exist, and that the Dogger Bank phases are tied to evidence.
sections.why: Likely reason: the import must not invent sources or drop the qualifications that make financial figures correct.
sections.watch_out: The reference rule uses text patterns on the claim value, so reformatting the claim text can make a valid reference look unsupported.

sections.name: test: for
sections.title: Checks for Dogger Bank, conformance and roles
sections.what: Confirms each Dogger Bank phase has evidence, that the record conversion keeps the attributes it was given, that the source pack has one entry per host name, and that required roles such as EPC and offtaker are assigned to the right companies. It also checks that every role points to claims that exist.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code beyond the test names. The role checks are there so that owning a project does not automatically make a company an operator.
sections.watch_out: The role checks name specific companies, so a company rename in the source would fail them.
